parameters.content:
## Receive

One turn per call: sessionId, transcript, ASR confidence.

## Load state

Prompts (goals, rules, spoken lines), the session row and the market row are the only state the model sees.

## Gates

YesNoGate: a deterministic yes or no in IDENTIFY (identified caller), CONSENT, DEALER, CONFIRM and CONFIRM_CANCEL, a spoken journey in NEED (cancel, reschedule, callback, self-service), a chosen service in SERVICES and a date in LOOKUP move the state before the model runs, so a small model cannot loop on a confirmed question or forget a tool call.

## Prefetch and prompt

The sub-workflow a gate implies runs here, deterministically: the appointment search on cancel or reschedule, the reservation on dealer agreed, the slot search on services chosen or a new date, the cancel, book or move on the caller's yes. Its result goes into the facts and the model reads it out instead of calling the tool. Then the system prompt is composed.

## Reason

The agent has nine tools (one per joint-scope step), Postgres memory and a structured parser with auto-fix.

## Guards 1: gates

ClampOutput: only values the schema allows, only a state transition the table allows (illegal_transition), a journey intent sticks for the call. Then each rule is an If (the condition) and an Edit Fields (what it changes). Gates: a deterministic yes or no in IDENTIFY and CONSENT wins over the model.

## Guards 2: caller, identification and outcomes

Caller asks for a person: handoff. Two failed identifications: handoff. OutcomeSync: a booking, move, cancellation or callback written by a tool forces its state. A booking, move or cancellation claim without a tool result is replaced by a question. Self-service instructions are read out verbatim.

## Guards 3: reply and end

Empty or over-long replies are fixed. A handoff always speaks the market's handover line. No end before a journey outcome (BOOKED, MOVED, CANCELLED, CALLBACK_LOGGED, SELF_SERVICE) or WRAPUP.

## Handoff

A model failure answers with a fixed apology and PLATFORM_ERROR. Any handoff builds the Refer-To through AR-14.

## Respond

Session update, event row, the reply the gateway speaks.

## AR-02 Dialogue turn

The brain. State lives in ar_sessions; the system prompt is rebuilt every turn. Guards after the model: no booking claim without a confirmation code, no slot that was not offered, no end before WRAPUP.

## Tools

IdentifyCaller, FindDealers, CreateReservation, FindSlots, BookAppointment, FindAppointment, CancelAppointment, MoveAppointment, RequestCallback. sessionId is plumbed, never a model parameter. Handoff is not a tool: it is a deterministic consequence of action=handoff.

meta.description: POST /webhook/ar/v1/session/turn. One call per caller utterance. Loads the session, runs the dialogue agent with its nine tools (identify, dealers, reservation, slots, book, find, cancel, move, callback), applies deterministic guards, builds the handoff context when needed, updates the session and logs. Returns speak, action, state and handoff.
